description: Defines the XValue class representing a value on the X-axis in chart objects within the MigraDoc Document Object Model. Includes properties for setting/getting the value, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: XValue
classes.description: Represents an X-axis value in a chart, allowing for value assignment, cloning, and serialization.

classes.name: XValueValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable properties for the XValue, specifically the 'Value' property.

methods.name: XValue()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the internal values.

methods.name: XValue(string? value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing XValue with a specified string value.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XValue instance.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the XValue to its DDL representation.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Provides meta-information about the XValue class.
